An interesting story between China and US navy in South China Sea 2016, from Grok:

Grok:

Event Background: Arbitration Case Ignites the Powder Keg

· Cause of the Arbitration Case: In 2013, with US support, the Philippines initiated an arbitration case against China at the Permanent Court of Arbitration in The Hague. The focus was whether China's "nine-dash line" claim and its island-building activities violated the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS). China refused to participate from the outset, calling the arbitration "illegal and invalid." On July 12, 2016, the tribunal issued a ruling fully in favor of the Philippines, rejecting China's historic rights, which caused an international uproar. China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs responded: "China's sovereignty and maritime rights and interests in the South China Sea are not affected by the award."
· Escalating US-China Rivalry: Prior to the ruling, the US had already increased Freedom of Navigation Operations (FONOPs) in the South China Sea through its "Asia-Pacific Rebalance" strategy. For example, in January 2016, the destroyer USS Curtis Wilbur entered within 12 nautical miles of the Paracel Islands. After the ruling, the US saw the award as an "opportunity" to strengthen military involvement, proclaiming it was upholding "freedom of navigation." China, in response, accelerated its island-building efforts (e.g., on Mischief Reef and Fiery Cross Reef) and conducted naval patrols.

Peak Military Standoff: Dual Carriers vs. Three Fleets

· US Military Actions: In early July, the US unusually deployed two carrier strike groups (USS Ronald Reagan and USS John C. Stennis), accompanied by over 10 escort ships/destroyers, approximately 150 aircraft, and around 12,000 personnel, into the Philippine Sea area of the South China Sea. This was described by then Defense Secretary Ashton Carter as a "show of determination," aimed at deterring China and supporting allies. The US military conducted joint exercises (e.g., "Valiant Shield"), with aircraft repeatedly flying over disputed airspace and ships approaching contested features.
· China's Response: The Chinese navy entered its highest level of combat readiness. Nearly all forces from its three fleets (East Sea, South Sea, and North Sea Fleets) were deployed – totaling over 100 ships (including Type 052C/D destroyers, Type 054A frigates, and submarine squadrons) and hundreds of aircraft (J-11s, H-6K bombers), involving more than 100,000 personnel total. The South Sea Fleet's main force assembled at Woody Island, the East Sea Fleet blockaded the Taiwan Strait, and the North Sea Fleet moved south for support. Chinese H-6K bombers conducted patrols over Scarborough Shoal, and land-based "YJ-12" anti-ship missiles were positioned, creating an "Anti-Access/Area Denial" (A2/AD) posture.
· 'Last Letters' Details: Chinese sources reported that officers and sailors involved in the operations (especially from the South Sea Fleet) collectively wrote "last letters" or wills before deployment, which were bagged and sent ashore, reflecting a "defend to the death" resolve. Some naval architecture experts reportedly even "wrote letters in blood" vowing not to leave their ships, pledging to live or die with their vessels. This was seen as psychological mobilization, though unconfirmed by Western media, and could have been for internal motivation or propaganda.

'Close Encounters' and Risk of Conflict

· Multiple Close Calls: During the standoff (July 12-25), dozens of close encounters occurred between US and Chinese ships/aircraft:
  · The US destroyer USS Benfold approached Mischief Reef; the Chinese Type 052D destroyer Xi'an closed to within several hundred meters and locked its fire-control radar on the US ship.

@qinbafrank Grok：

事件背景：仲裁案点燃火药桶
•  仲裁案起因：2013年，菲律宾在美国支持下，向海牙常设仲裁法院提起南海仲裁，焦点是中国“九段线”主张及岛礁建设是否违反《联合国海洋法公约》（UNCLOS）。中国从一开始就拒绝参与，称仲裁“非法、无效”。 2016年7月12日，仲裁庭裁决完全支持菲律宾，否定中国历史性权利，引发国际哗然。中国外交部回应：“中国在南海的主权和相关权益不受仲裁影响。”
•  中美博弈升级：仲裁前，美国已通过“亚太再平衡”战略增加南海“自由航行行动”（FONOPs），如2016年1月驱逐舰“柯蒂斯·威尔伯”号闯入西沙群岛12海里内。 仲裁后，美国视裁决为“机会”，加强军事介入，宣称维护“航行自由”。中国则加速岛礁建设（如美济礁永暑礁），并通过海军巡航回应。
军事对峙高峰：双航母 vs. 三大舰队
•  美军行动：7月上旬，美国罕见部署两个航母战斗群（USS Ronald Reagan 和 USS John C. Stennis），携10余艘护卫舰/驱逐舰、约150架战机、1.2万士兵，进入南海菲律宾海域。 这被时任国防部长阿什顿·卡特称为“展示决心”，旨在威慑中国并支持盟友。美军进行联合演习（如“利剑”），飞机多次飞越争议空域，舰艇靠近岛礁。
•  中国回应：中国海军进入一级战备，三大舰队（东海、南海、北海）几乎全军出动——逾100艘舰艇（包括052C/D驱逐舰、054A护卫舰、潜艇群）、上百架战机（歼-11、轰-6K），总兵力超10万。 南海舰队主力集结永兴岛，东海舰队封锁台湾海峡，北海舰队北上支援。 中国空军轰-6K轰炸机巡航黄岩岛，陆基“鹰击-12”反舰导弹就位，形成“反介入/区域拒止”（A2/AD）态势。
•  官兵“遗书”细节：中文来源称，参与行动的官兵（尤其是南海舰队）在出动前集体写遗书/遗嘱，装袋上岸，体现“誓死捍卫”的决心。 造船专家甚至“写血书”拒下舰，誓与战舰共存亡。 这被视为心理动员，但无西方媒体证实，可能为内部激励或宣传元素。
“亲密接触”与擦枪走火风险
•  多次险情：对峙期（7月12-25日），中美军舰/飞机数十次近距离接触：
•  美驱逐舰“本福德”号靠近美济礁，中方052D驱逐舰“西安”号逼近至数百米，雷达锁定。
•  美P-8A侦察机低飞，中国歼-11战机拦截，距仅45米（“危险接近”）。
•  中国潜艇疑似跟踪美航母，轰-6K模拟反舰攻击。 美方报告称，中国舰艇“专业违规机动”（unsafe maneuvers），中方则指责美“挑衅入侵”。
•  最接近动手：7月12-15日，双方舰机在 Scarborough Shoal（黄岩岛）周边对峙，美航母编队距中国岛礁仅数百公里。中国情报锁定美航母坐标，通过信息战（媒体暗示“暴露位置”）施压。 风险极高：任何误判（如碰撞）可能引发连锁反应，类似于2001年南海撞机事件。
结局：美军“退走”与中国“完胜”叙事
•  美军撤离：7月下旬，美双航母群悄然东撤至菲律宾以东海域，美军称“任务完成，转向韩日演习”。 中国媒体解读为“心理战胜利”——航母“发现即摧毁”，美方避开火力圈。 实际，美方强调这是“例行部署”，非退让。
•  后续影响：对峙后，南海短期稳定。菲律宾杜特尔特上台（2016年6月），转向亲华，访华缓和中菲关系。 但紧张未消：2016年底，中国部署“辽宁”号航母巡航南海。 这事件凸显中美“灰色地带”对抗模式——无直接开火，但擦枪走火风险常存。
事实 vs. 争议：平衡视角
•  中国叙事：强调“以弱胜强”，2016年中国军力远逊美（航母仅1艘），但通过不对称战术（导弹+岛链）迫退对手，证明“核心利益不容侵犯”。“遗书”等细节增强民族自豪感。
•  西方/美方叙事：视之为“成功威慑”，仲裁案后美军常态化巡航，盟友（如菲越）获信心。 无“遗书”或“完败”报道，焦点在“规则-based order”。
•  客观评估：这是中美近十年最危险一刻，风险源于误判而非蓄意。 如今（2025年），中国海军已超美（3艘航母、全球最大舰队），美“重返亚太”更难，但博弈转向多域（网络、太空）。正如帖子所言，“16年都没能做到，现在老美更难做到了”——中国军力跃升是关键因素。
